artifact: Version-matched NVRMFB EDID HiDPI experimental package
edid_scope: Digital EDID 1.3/1.4 base block; first explicitly preferred non-interlaced DTD and base physical size
undefined_import_comparison: Each payload matches its own unmodified release baseline: 466 (1.15.0), 467 (2.0.1/2.0.2), 471 (2.0.4), 478 (2.3.6/2.4.3).
sanitizer_policy_tests: passed; multiple geometries, corrupt/truncated EDID, fallback sizing, caps/aspect and 100000 arbitrary-input trials
hardware_validation: No cross-device hardware qualification; no personal device history included.
documentation: Bilingual, English first; prominent cautions; paired backup, staged manual installation, macOS rollback and offline Recovery procedures.

command_tools.root_helper_transaction_fixtures: Passed separately on 1.15.0, 2.0.1, 2.0.2, 2.0.4, 2.3.6 and 2.4.3 fixtures: paired backup/install/restore, preflight/live-build failure, restore-publish failure, cross-release backup rejection, and unsupported 2.0.3 rejection.
command_tools.ui: Automatic Chinese/English; concise normal output, full diagnostic log
command_tools.language_tests: Passed: Simplified/Traditional Chinese preferences, English/other-language fallback, explicit zh/en overrides.
command_tools.external_backup: Byte-only copy and hash verification; no APFS flags, ACLs or xattrs; incomplete marker blocks restore; safe permissions reconstructed on restore; FAT32 individual files must be <=4294967295 bytes.
command_tools.portable_backup_tests: Passed simulated APFS/exFAT/FAT32 branches, initial/refresh, copy failure/incomplete marker, path/symlink refusal, and FAT32 >4 GiB refusal. Real temporary FAT32 and APFS disk images passed initial/refresh byte/hash verification and xattr stripping. Creating a real exFAT test image required unavailable OS authorization; exFAT has fixture coverage only.
command_tools.external_copy_frontend_gate_tests: Passed: initial external copy failure prevents install; post-install refresh failure reports installation state and do-not-reboot warning, never success.

compatibility_feedback.source: Compatibility feedback supplied for documentation; not independently reproduced
compatibility_feedback.additional_feedback: User reported NVDriver 2.0.2 working on 2026-10-16; no complete device/version or higher-mode matrix supplied.

2.0.2.source_comparison: Framebuffer and related ABI headers identical to v2.0.1; rebuilt independently from v2.0.2; UUID matches, exact binary checksum recorded separately.

2.0.4.source_comparison: Built from upstream v2.0.4, preserving its GPU sleep/wake and framebuffer notification changes. HiDPI patch applies cleanly; imports match unmodified v2.0.4 baseline.

2.3.6.source_comparison: Ported onto upstream v2.3.6 with upstream nvrm_off.h. Gamma/cursor/display/flip/sleep code and native nvfbhidpi computeScanoutCaps function preserved; 478 imports match baseline. No duplicate allocation expansion.

2.4.3.source_comparison: Built from upstream v2.4.3, preserving THREAD_CALL_OPTIONS_ONCE serialized callbacks, opt-in trace publishing and native nvfbhidpi computeScanoutCaps unchanged; all 478 imports match the v2.4.3 baseline, including thread_call_allocate_with_options.

additional_boot_argument: nvfbhidpiscaled=1 (requires nvfbhidpi=1); separately gated, default off
higher_modes: New unverified supersampled mode path: 1.25x, 4/3x, 1.5x, 1.6x, 1.75x, 2x backing dimensions; exact/even aspect only; max 7680x4320; bounds checked against actual allocated bytes; uses existing NVKMS-validated preferred raster timing.
new_revision_hardware_validation: New higher-mode path and revised installer have not been installed on physical hardware by this task; previous user compatibility reports do not validate this revision.
sanitizer_scaled_mode_tests: Passed: 2560x1440 and 2560x1600 higher candidates; exact physical timing and DSC preservation; duplicates, capacity, insufficient memory, malformed dimensions, and 100000 bounded-input trials under ASan/UBSan.
higher_modes_fallback: Allocation failure uses existing boot-size fallback; enlarged kernel mapping failure also reduces to boot-sized backing and omits larger modes.
